bodyHtml:
We are excited to officially launch the club's newest addition, The White Kit. Our first official Away kit.

Featuring a bright white base, trimmed with our signature green and red, topped off with a classic striped polo collar.

The White Kit is a testament to where Spindles started, what it has become, and where it is headed.

Another marvel that was designed in partnership with Icarus Football Company.

The half-red and half-green trim was designed to match the club's current shorts and socks. Eliminating the need for another pair of shorts and socks.

The front of the shirt features Engineering Company Guth DeConzo for a second year straight. A special thank you to Jeremy McDonald of Guth for continuing this partnership.

The left red sleeve sports Primeau's Autobody of Cohoes, one of our day one sponsors and supporters. A shout-out to Dwayne and the Primeau family for their continued support.

The right green sleeve features a new face in the Spindles Family. 7 Brothers Landscaping joins the new away kit. We are excited to begin this new partnership with Owener, Serge Karakalchu!

Also featured on the right green sleeve is the CDSL Badge, our league for the 2024 season.

Lastly, on the back is our sister company Bear Digital. Through club owner Jarron Frangie, Bear is the official digital media manager of Spindles United Football Club.

So what is the best part of this kit?

Is it the big, loud, red numbers sported on the back? Or maybe the classic white polo-collar inspired by the old-era Cohoes? How about the small word details on the sleeve cuffs?

No matter what it is, you can get the kit yourself very soon at icarusfc.com

You can also watch the full kit release video, filmed at the Cohoes Music Hall thanks to Owen Smith, right here.
